recognize_zh: 這是家族譜系圖（非形態圖）：先證者（箭頭，41 歲女性）罹患 CMML 並有疣與 M. kansasii 感染，姐姐 43 歲 MDS 轉 AML，兩人皆帶 GATA2 p.A286V；父親有血小板低下，堂表親有白血病，顯示體染色體顯性遺傳的骨髓腫瘤傾向。
features: Pedigree chart with proband (arrow): 41-year-old female with CMML, warts and Mycobacterium kansasii infection
Affected sister aged 43 with MDS progressing to AML; both sisters marked as GATA2 p.A286V carriers
Father with thrombocytopenia, deceased of colon cancer at 70; paternal-side male relative with leukemia
Offspring with urogenital anomalies (duplicated ureters, ureteral reflux) and warts in the proband's daughter
Pattern consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance across generations
describe_en: The figure is a family pedigree rather than a morphologic image. The proband, a 41-year-old woman with CMML, warts and Mycobacterium kansasii infection, and her 43-year-old sister with MDS evolving to AML both carry the germline GATA2 p.A286V variant. The father had thrombocytopenia, another relative developed leukemia, and the next generation shows warts and urogenital anomalies (duplicated ureters, ureteral reflux). The combination of familial myeloid neoplasia, atypical mycobacterial and HPV infection and urogenital malformations is characteristic of GATA2 deficiency syndrome.
